user.title: Hue Insist
user.description: Verifies that light commands were actually carried out and repairs lamps that missed the command. The defaults work as they are.

data.unavailable_exceptions: Correct anyway, even when they report unavailable
data.settle_timeout: Maximum extra wait for the bridge to finish

data_description.delay: The grace period the bridge gets to start. Right after a command no lamp has reported back yet, so checking immediately would judge the bridge before it began. Verification never happens sooner than this; waiting for the bridge to finish is added on top.
data_description.settle_timeout: After the minimum wait, verification holds off for as long as the lamps are still changing state, so a large request is judged only once the bridge is done. This caps that extra wait. Set to 0 to verify straight after the minimum wait.
data_description.command_rate: The bridge handles about ten light commands per second and silently drops the rest, so corrections are spread out rather than fired all at once.
data_description.debug_log: Writes a line per caught request, per deviating lamp and per correction to the Home Assistant log. Takes effect immediately.

abort.already_configured: Hue Insist is already set up.
